prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: preview-only architectural concept for a software-company interactive HQ world. Create ONE beautifully crafted original Building Suit tower, a full-height landmark building with three generous modular office tiers and a strong tall silhouette, on a compact landscaped foundation. Top usable floor is reserved for CEO; the next floor below is HR; bottom tier is an empty architectural shell whose function is undecided. Prominent exact text BUILDING SUIT as large architectural lettering integrated on the top crown. No other text, no extra departments. This is a playful but premium, richly textured stylized 3D game-world miniature, subtly pixel influenced yet rendered with dimensional detail, like an intricately crafted game environment rather than a flat SVG dashboard. Three-quarter orthographic view from front-right, full building and small foundation visible, strong vertical composition, portrait 3:4 framing. Design only the building exterior; no people, agents, characters or UI. Show interiors only as a warm glow behind glazing, not labelled cutaways. Memorable corporate landmark crown reminiscent of the ambition of a superhero headquarters, but entirely original architecture and Building Suit branding, without Marvel or Avengers symbols. Tasteful cinematic lighting, readable floors and doors, finely modelled masonry/glass/metal, suitable later to walk around in an interactive company world. No village, scattered houses, task counters, activity bubbles or watermark. This is a proposed visual direction, not a new company brand. VARIANT A — SKYLINE CROWN: sleek blue-green glass and brushed silver structural ribbons; a slightly asymmetric stepped outline and elegant cantilevered illuminated crown carrying the BUILDING SUIT wordmark. Restrained icy cyan highlights. Executive penthouse glazed all around above the HR tier. Midnight blue studio-like environment with dusk glow, compact dark stone foundation and a few tiny sculpted plants. Sophisticated, ambitious, inviting, with premium architectural craftsmanship. Keep the building as the dominant subject.
